_comment: Supplementary loan facts for the Leak Fixer 'high-interest loan, switch advice' feature. A bank statement only shows the EMI debit (see bank_statement_riya_sharma_q3fy26.json), not the interest rate or outstanding principal -- those come from the user's loan statement or manual entry. Not an AI Studio reader target; feeds rules_engine/tests fixtures directly in Milestone 2. Rate is illustrative/sample, not a verified current market rate -- real comparison rates belong in config/rules/<fy>.yaml marked UNVERIFIED until a CA/analyst sources them. outstanding_principal is set to the value that makes monthly_emi exactly consistent with annual_interest_rate_percent and remaining_tenure_months under the standard amortization formula (rules_engine/loans.py), so this fixture self-checks.
